name: a stated hour something is due by stays a commitment
why: The other side of the same rule, and the reason it is stated as a discriminator rather than as 'times become engagements'. A 5pm cutoff is not a place to be at 5pm: the owner can do it any time before, so it takes a due date and no block. Loosening the engagement rule without this case would turn every deadline into a meeting.
